title: Projected Economic Benefits and Job Creation from Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone Cooperation
what_it_is: Projected Economic Benefits and Job Creation from Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone Cooperation

sections.label: Business benefits from JS-SEZ
sections.summary: Businesses in manufacturing, logistics and digital economy can benefit from improved cross-border flow and ease of doing business in the JS-SEZ.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Businesses across sectors including manufacturing, logistics and digital economy can benefit from the improved cross-border flow of goods and people, and ease of doing business in the JS-SEZ.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Firms could benefit from siting some of their operations in Johor to take advantage of the resources there, whilst focusing headquarters and research functions in Singapore, where we have relative strengths.

sections.label: Support schemes for JS-SEZ investors
sections.summary: Eligible Singapore companies investing in the JS-SEZ can seek support from Enterprise Singapore schemes, and Malaysia announced an incentive package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Eligible Singapore companies investing in the JS-SEZ can seek support from schemes such as the Market Readiness Assistance Grant and Enterprise Financing Scheme administered by Enterprise Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Malaysia has also announced an incentive package for the JS-SEZ, including special corporate and income tax rates for qualifying investments, and intend to announce more details when ready.

sections.label: JS-SEZ competitive edge
sections.summary: If executed well, the JS-SEZ will give Singapore an additional competitive edge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If executed well, the JS-SEZ will give us that additional competitive edge.

sections.label: Leveraging Johor's strengths
sections.summary: The JS-SEZ will give Singapore the opportunity to leverage on Johor's strengths to overcome its inherent weaknesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Second, the JS-SEZ will also give us the opportunity to leverage on Johor's strengths to overcome our inherent weaknesses.

sections.label: Attracting new companies and investors
sections.summary: The final objective is to attract new companies and investors that may not have considered Singapore as an investment destination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The final objective is to attract new companies, new investors that hitherto may not have considered Singapore as an investment destination or potentially even maybe, Singapore is a little bit lower on their list of places to invest.

sections.label: Singapore firms with operations both sides
sections.summary: In discussions with many Singapore firms, they do intend to have operations on both sides.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In our discussions with many of the Singapore firms, they do intend to have operations on both sides.
